jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst — fictional
jobs.body:
FICTIONAL PRACTICE ADVERT — NOT A LIVE VACANCY
Junior Data Analyst | Example Insights | Den Haag
32–40 hours per week; hybrid working.
Prepare weekly reports, clean spreadsheet data, write basic SQL queries and explain findings to operations colleagues. Required: confidence in Excel, basic SQL, careful checking and clear English. Dutch is helpful; no formal level is required in this fictional advert. A small portfolio or relevant operational experience is welcome. Actual travel time must be checked by the applicant.
jobs.reason: A practical first direction to explore: Sam can demonstrate spreadsheet reporting, record checking and basic SQL. Communication needs and travel arrangements still deserve a conversation.

requirements.evidence: At Example Retail, Sam cleaned weekly records in Excel and prepared reports. Recorded skills include filters, pivot tables and lookup formulas.
requirements.nextStep: Prepare one example showing a cleaned record and the resulting summary.

requirements.evidence: The personal project contains six saved queries using SELECT, GROUP BY and JOIN with 200 invented records.
requirements.nextStep: Be ready to explain one join and check its result.

requirements.evidence: Sam checked missing values and duplicates in weekly order records.
requirements.nextStep: Describe the check and how an issue was resolved; do not invent a business impact.

requirements.evidence: Sam reports English B2 and has experience explaining summaries to colleagues. No independent language assessment or English interview evidence is supplied.
requirements.nextStep: Practise a short explanation of the project in English.

requirements.text: Work pattern and practical travel fit
requirements.evidence: Sam prefers 32–40 hours and a journey up to 45 minutes. The advert is in Den Haag, but the exact office location and required office days are not supplied.
requirements.nextStep: Ask about office days and check the actual journey.

jobs.title: Data Engineer — fictional
jobs.body:
FICTIONAL PRACTICE ADVERT — NOT A LIVE VACANCY
Data Engineer | Example Data Services | Rotterdam
36–40 hours per week; hybrid working.
Build and support scheduled data pipelines. Required: Python, strong SQL, Git, automated tests and two years of relevant engineering experience. Experience with a cloud data platform is expected. English is used in the team. The advert does not state whether Dutch is required. Actual travel time and availability are unknown.
jobs.reason: An adjacent future direction with substantial engineering gaps. The current facts support some SQL practice, but do not show the required production experience.

requirements.evidence: No production Python experience or Python project is recorded.
requirements.nextStep: Start with one small script that reads and validates an invented CSV file.

requirements.evidence: Sam has basic SELECT, GROUP BY and JOIN from six personal-project queries. That does not establish strong production SQL.
requirements.nextStep: Practise more complex joins, aggregation and correctness checks; keep the examples.

requirements.evidence: Only introductory Git practice is recorded.
requirements.nextStep: Save the learning project in Git and practise a small branch and review.
Add tests for missing values, duplicate IDs and invalid types to a small pipeline.

requirements.evidence: No cloud platform experience is recorded.
requirements.nextStep: Learn local pipeline concepts first; decide later whether a cloud exercise is useful.

requirements.text: Two years of relevant engineering experience
requirements.evidence: The recorded work is operations and administration; no two-year engineering role is shown.
requirements.nextStep: Look for a role aligned with current evidence while building targeted experience.

requirements.evidence: The fictional advert uses English but does not state a Dutch requirement.
requirements.nextStep: Ask the employer; do not infer the answer from the advert language.

jobs.title: Platform / Cloud DevOps Engineer — fictional
jobs.body:
FICTIONAL PRACTICE ADVERT — NOT A LIVE VACANCY
Platform / Cloud DevOps Engineer | Example Cloud Operations | Amsterdam
40 hours per week; some on-call duties.
Maintain Linux services, automate infrastructure and troubleshoot releases. Required: Linux, networking, scripting, Git, containers, infrastructure as code and experience supporting production systems. Customer conversations require Dutch B2. The advert does not describe on-call compensation or exact office days.
jobs.reason: A possible long-term interest, with several foundational gaps. This sample comparison does not recommend applying on the assumption that these requirements are already met.

requirements.evidence: No Linux or networking experience is recorded.
requirements.nextStep: Try a small local Linux learning exercise and explain how a request reaches a service.

requirements.evidence: Introductory Git practice is recorded; no scripting project is recorded.
requirements.nextStep: Create a small script and keep a clear Git history.

requirements.evidence: No container or infrastructure-as-code work is recorded.
requirements.nextStep: Defer these until basic scripting and systems concepts are comfortable.

requirements.evidence: Sam has administrative and operational experience, but no production-system support role is shown.
requirements.nextStep: Identify a foundation role or a project with observable troubleshooting evidence.

requirements.evidence: The fictional profile records Dutch A2, not B2.
requirements.nextStep: Keep the stated level truthful and choose a realistic language-learning goal.

requirements.evidence: The advert mentions on-call duties without compensation or schedule details.
requirements.nextStep: Ask about the schedule, support arrangements and compensation.
